== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Ng'ok (Japanese)|Ng'ok]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67788 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(14, 8, 461, 622)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>6b9c3d2fb308000b5a80054c11eb557adc5da487ea39ab7ff3f9439a232f72f1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/1e/Japanese-ANH-Ngok-SWCA-67788.jpg Internet Archive item].
